description: The Systemathic Language (docs/foundation.md, Part I), written in the kernel. Each Relationship is a pair of ends; an end's range counts how many instances of its entity each instance at the other end is linked to.

axioms.about: Relationship ends are in the Relationship's Language
axioms.formula: all r in Relationship, e in r.ends. e.entity.language == r.language

axioms.about: Parameter types are in the Interaction's Language
axioms.formula: all i in Interaction, p in i.parameters. p.type.language == i.language

axioms.about: The output is in the Interaction's Language
axioms.formula: all i in Interaction. i.output.language == i.language

axioms.about: A formula mentions only its own Language's Entities
axioms.formula: all f in Formula, x in f.mentionedEntities. x.language == f.language

axioms.about: A formula mentions only its own Language's ends
axioms.formula: all f in Formula, x in f.mentionedEnds. x.relationship.language == f.language

axioms.about: A constraint is in its Relationship's Language
axioms.formula: all f in Formula, r in f.constrains. r.language == f.language

axioms.about: min <= max, where max is present
axioms.formula: all e in End, m in e.max. m in e.min.*successor

axioms.about: Bounds are well-founded: no Bound succeeds itself
axioms.formula: all b in Bound. not b in b.^successor

axioms.about: From any Entity, the ends reachable across its Relationships have distinct names
axioms.formula: all a in End, b in End, na in a.relationship.ends, nb in b.relationship.ends. (a != b and na != a and nb != b and na.entity == nb.entity) => a.name != b.name

axioms.about: A Transformation's source is in scope of its holder
axioms.formula: all t in Transformation. t.source in t.holder.*references.languages

axioms.about: A Transformation's target is in scope of its holder
axioms.formula: all t in Transformation. t.target in t.holder.*references.languages

axioms.about: A Relationship mapping requires both end Entities mapped
axioms.formula: all m in RelationshipMapping, e in m.source.ends. some n in m.transformation.entityMappings. n.source == e.entity

axioms.about: An Interaction mapping requires its Parameter types mapped
axioms.formula: all m in InteractionMapping, p in m.source.parameters. some n in m.transformation.entityMappings. n.source == p.type

axioms.about: An Interaction mapping requires its output mapped
axioms.formula: all m in InteractionMapping. some n in m.transformation.entityMappings. n.source == m.source.output

axioms.about: Every Mediation is witnessed by a reversible Transformation of its mediator
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation. some t in m.mediator.transformations, v in t.reverse. t.source in m.what.*references.languages and t.target in m.how.*references.languages

axioms.about: Entity mapping sources are in the source Language
axioms.formula: all m in EntityMapping. m.source.language == m.transformation.source

axioms.about: Entity mapping targets are in the target Language
axioms.formula: all m in EntityMapping, x in m.targets. x.language == m.transformation.target

axioms.about: Relationship mapping sources are in the source Language
axioms.formula: all m in RelationshipMapping. m.source.language == m.transformation.source

axioms.about: Relationship mapping targets are in the target Language
axioms.formula: all m in RelationshipMapping, x in m.targets. x.language == m.transformation.target

axioms.about: Target Relationships join images of the source Relationship's ends
axioms.formula: all m in RelationshipMapping, r in m.targets, e in r.ends. some n in m.transformation.entityMappings, s in m.source.ends. n.source == s.entity and e.entity in n.targets

axioms.about: Interaction mapping sources are in the source Language
axioms.formula: all m in InteractionMapping. m.source.language == m.transformation.source

axioms.about: Interaction mapping targets are in the target Language
axioms.formula: all m in InteractionMapping, x in m.targets. x.language == m.transformation.target

axioms.about: A reverse's context is drawn from its Transformation's Languages
axioms.formula: all v in Reverse, e in v.context. e.language == v.transformation.source or e.language == v.transformation.target

axioms.about: Every Parameter of an Interaction is on its first/next chain
axioms.formula: all i in Interaction, p in i.parameters. p in i.first.*next

axioms.about: The first/next chain holds only the Interaction's Parameters
axioms.formula: all i in Interaction, p in i.first.*next. p in i.parameters

axioms.about: The chain has no cycles
axioms.formula: all p in Parameter. not p in p.^next

axioms.about: A Domain references only Languages of its own System
axioms.formula: all d in Domain, l in d.languages. l.system == d.system

axioms.about: A Domain references only Domains of its own System
axioms.formula: all d in Domain, r in d.references. r.system == d.system

axioms.about: A Mediation relates only Domains of its own System
axioms.formula: all m in Mediation. m.what.system == m.system and m.how.system == m.system and m.mediator.system == m.system
